overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair did not reasonably anticipate discussion of the fire chief hiring and snow plowing topics, which another member raised unexpectedly.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed a fire chief hiring update and a snow plowing policy at its February 14 meeting though neither appeared on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: We find no indication that the Chair anticipated discussion on either topic.
